== Charlie Arlandson's Day 1 finish ==
The [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2023-04-us-nationals-minneapolis-minnesota-april-1-2/ PC 2023 US Nationals coverage] lists [[Charlie Arlandson]] at #1 in the Day 1 standings. The Day 1 table here shows him at 2. I've left the finish as it is until someone checks the final standings.
